scenarios.title: Each mode chosen beyond the first adds the escalate cost
decisions: A casts Borrowed Hostility choosing both modes: mode 1 targets Grizzly Bears (+3/+0) and mode 2 targets Grizzly Bears (first strike).
A pays {R} plus the escalate cost {3} for the second mode by tapping all four Mountains.
Both players pass; Borrowed Hostility resolves.

variants.label: two_modes
variants.expected: The total cost is {3}{R}, four mana, all four Mountains are tapped. Borrowed Hostility resolves; Grizzly Bears is 5/2 with first strike until end of turn. Borrowed Hostility moves to A's graveyard.

variants.label: one_mode
variants.expected: No escalate cost is added: the total cost is {R}, one Mountain is tapped and three stay untapped. Grizzly Bears is 5/2 without first strike until end of turn.

variants.label: two_modes_three_lands
variants.delta: A controls three Mountains instead of four, and chooses both modes.
variants.expected: The total cost is {3}{R}, four mana, and A has only three lands. Casting Borrowed Hostility with both modes is not legal; the spell stays in A's hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Variant two_modes_three_lands changes the number of Mountains in the base setup from four to three.
